Raj (Partner Lead): Quick heads-up — Channel partner Satori wants to start the joint POC next week. They asked for a checklist: SSO, data residency, pricing cap, and security questionnaire answers. Can we confirm who owns what?
Alice (Solutions Eng): I can own SSO + onboarding runbook. Need Satori's IdP metadata and test tenant by EOD Thu.
Maria (Presales): I'll take pricing cap and usage estimates. Can you share expected token volumes + peak qps, @Tom?
Tom (Account Exec): Sales estimates: 40k tokens/day baseline, spike to ~120k/day during demo. They want a 3-week POC with a $X/day soft cap proposal.
Jenna (Security Engineer): I'll handle the security questionnaire. Share the egress architecture diagram and whether logs contain user PII.
Raj (Partner Lead): Good. Two blockers Satori raised: 1) can Redwood run within their VPC for audit reasons? 2) they want SLA language during POC — even just availability targets.
Alice (Solutions Eng): For VPC: Redwood Private is an option but requires infra onboarding. ETA for a minimal proof: ~2 weeks to spin a Private sandbox. For hosted, we can provide IP allowlist + tenant isolation quicker.
Maria (Presales): Pricing options: we can do a fixed POC credit + overage rate. I'll draft a one-pager. Need confirmation on quantization profile (fp16 vs int8) — that'll affect cost estimates.
Tom (Account Exec): Satori prefers hosted for speed. I'll push them on accepting hosted + IP allowlist if we can meet their compliance needs. Will share IdP contact.
Jenna (Security Engineer): Quick Q re: logs — do we redact prompt inputs upstream? We normally persist telemetry but can enable prompt redaction for POC. Also need to know third-party embeddings usage.
Alice (Solutions Eng): Suggested runbook snippet for required inputs:
```
- IdP metadata XML
- Test tenant name + admin email
- Sample traffic pattern (qps, avg token length)
- Allowed egress CIDRs
```
Raj (Partner Lead): Action items:
- @Alice: prepare SSO runbook and sample deployment config by Thu
- @Maria: POC pricing one-pager by Fri
- @Jenna: start security questionnaire, will ping Satori for SOC2 scope
- @Tom: get IdP metadata + confirm hosted vs private preference
infra-bot: New task created: PARTNER-4121 "Satori POC - onboarding" assigned to Alice, due 2026-03-30
Maria (Presales): Also flagged enterprise blocker — Satori asked for contract clause on data residency. Legal will need to weigh in; copying legal eng-legal.
Tom (Account Exec): Noted. I'll loop legal and propose the temporary agreement (POC addendum) to cover residency + SLA asks.
Alice (Solutions Eng): If they insist on Private for POC, we should surface the 2-week infra ETA to Tom ASAP so sales can adjust dates.
Raj (Partner Lead): Let's reconvene Mon 10am PT with updates. Thanks all :thumbsup:
